description: This file defines the ProximusProvider class, a specific implementation of the LoraProvider interface, providing methods to extract device IDs and payloads from LoRaWAN messages for the Proximus provider within an Eclipse Hono adapter.

classes.name: ProximusProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider with API for Proximus, implementing methods to extract device-specific information from incoming messages.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the provider, in this case 'proximus'.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Provides the URL path prefix specific to Proximus.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device ID from a JSON message based on the 'DevEUI' field.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload from a JSON message based on the 'payload' field.
